business_problem: TOPSPORTS wanted to scale enterprise AI agents beyond isolated pilots, but every new agent risked recreating the same knowledge, data, tools, and skills in separate silos. Business-analysis, membership, and marketing teams also lacked one control plane for coordinating complex tasks, enforcing cross-role permissions, measuring production value, tracing failures across models and tools, and assigning clear ownership for ongoing optimization.
solution_summary: TOPSPORTS used Alibaba Cloud AgentCore as the operating base for enterprise agent delivery and governance. At the bottom of the stack, the company organizes knowledge, business data, MCP connectors, and API tools as reusable resources rather than rebuilding them for each workflow. Above that resource layer, reusable skills package common tasks such as product lookup, inventory lookup, member segmentation, and anomaly attribution. Specialized agents for operations, merchandise, coaching, membership, and marketing are then assembled into teams around shared business goals. Employees interact through the TOPSPORTS AI Assistant, while a Team Leader decomposes requests, routes work to the right agents, and merges results. AgentCore provides asset management plus workspace, team, role, and credential controls, and AgentLoop adds usage observation, token tracking, trace analysis, evaluation, and iterative optimization across the full agent lifecycle.

solution_components.name: TOPSPORTS AI Assistant
solution_components.role: Serves as the employee-facing entry point where users submit business requests without having to choose a specific specialist agent.

solution_components.name: AgentCore
solution_components.role: Provides the shared build, runtime, collaboration, and governance base for enterprise agents, skills, tools, and credentials.

solution_components.name: Reusable Skills
solution_components.role: Package repeatable capabilities such as product lookup, inventory lookup, member segmentation, and anomaly attribution for reuse across agents.

solution_components.name: MCP tools
solution_components.role: Connect the agent system to underlying business data and tools so agent teams can act on operational and membership tasks.

solution_components.name: AgentLoop
solution_components.role: Captures token usage, execution traces, evaluation signals, and optimization feedback for governed production operation.

data_flow: Knowledge assets, business data, MCP connectors, and API tools are exposed as reusable resources and wrapped into skills inside AgentCore. A user submits a request to the TOPSPORTS AI Assistant, the Team Leader decomposes it, specialist agents invoke the needed skills and tools, and the combined result is returned to the user. AgentLoop records usage, traces, and evaluation feedback so the workflow can be governed and improved.
business_outcome: TOPSPORTS moved from isolated single-agent deployments to a governed collaborative system that lowers the barrier to using expert capabilities, shortens the cycle from insight to action, and turns business and IT co-operation into reusable enterprise intelligence assets. The company reports that business-analysis work can now be completed in 20 minutes and customer reactivation has improved to 12%.
metrics: business analysis time reduced to 20 minutes
maintains long-term partnerships with more than 20 sports brands
connects with more than 90 million accumulated users
architecture_clues: The architecture separates foundational resources, reusable skills, specialist agents, and the employee-facing assistant instead of embedding all logic in one agent.
AgentCore uses workspace, team, role, and credential management to enforce organizational boundaries across cross-functional agents.
A Team Leader decomposes requests and coordinates specialist agents around one business target before results are merged.
AgentLoop is used for token-consumption observation, trace analysis, evaluation, and continuous optimization across the agent lifecycle.
